goal: Make planned_legs.trip_id optional so a user can prefile a flight plan (.lnmpln upload or SimBrief import) with no trip at all — a "loose" prefile — and have every downstream consumer (listing, edit/cancel, flight linking, ACARS dispatch/weather/OOOI, ground-session dispatch/loadsheet access) treat it identically to a trip-linked prefile, while trip-linked prefile behavior stays byte-identical to today.
frozen_decisions: trip_id is optional for a prefiled flight plan; a prefiled flight is "loose" when trip_id is null/absent.
Prefiled flights retain a unique identifier regardless of trip association (the existing `planned_legs.id` primary key already does this — no new id scheme needed).
Out of scope: automatic creation of trips from loose prefiles; any ACARS business-logic change beyond making it eligible for non-trip legs.
Validation rules for flight-plan fields must stay identical between loose and trip-linked prefiles — only trip_id's requiredness changes.
sequencing_rationale: Phase 1 owns the one genuine schema/contract change (trip_id NOT NULL -> nullable) plus the CRUD and routes built directly on it. Nothing downstream can be implemented, let alone verified, before this lands, and the migration itself is the highest-risk single step in the run: SQLite has no ALTER COLUMN, and applySchema()'s existing CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS idiom never touches a table that already exists — the live flights.db's planned_legs table was created with trip_id NOT NULL and needs a real one-time rebuild, not a fresh-DB-only DDL edit. This satisfies AC1 and AC2 at the API layer and lays the getPlannedLegsForTrip/new-unified-listing groundwork AC5 needs.

Phase 2 is isolated from Phase 1's file set (flightManager.ts/types.ts vs schema.ts/db/plannedLegs.ts/routes) but strictly needs Phase 1's nullable trip_id and CRUD to exist first, since it exercises them end-to-end. Investigation before planning found ACARS itself (src/routes/acars.ts, src/acars.ts, src/db/acarsMessages.ts, src/routes/groundSessions.ts) already keys everything off planned_leg_id/flight_id with zero references to trip_id — grep confirms it — so this phase is mostly verification (AC3) plus the one real gap: FlightManager's PlannedLegCache and the PlannedLegLiveStatus/GroundSessionLiveStatus construction sites call getTripName(leg.trip_id) unconditionally and must not, once trip_id can be null.

Phase 3 is last because the client can't be built against a contract that doesn't exist yet, and because investigation surfaced two real latent bugs that only a loose leg would trigger: TripDetail.tsx's and Home.tsx's manual-link-flight pickers build their candidate list by fanning out over every trip's own /api/trips/:id/planned-legs, which structurally can never see a leg with no trip — without fixing this, AC4 (manage lifecycle / link) would silently fail for loose legs in the UI even though the API supports it. Similarly FlightDetail.tsx and AcarsMessages.tsx build a `/trip/${trip_id}` link unconditionally, which becomes a broken `/trip/null` link for a loose leg's flight.

Escape hatch ordering: within Phase 1, the two new loose-creation routes (the manual, explicit way to prefile without a trip) ship before Phase 3's UI wraps them — matching the project's rule that a manual/API path exists before any UI automates it. No auto-matching or auto-trip-creation is introduced anywhere in this run (frozen decision), so there is no automation to gate behind an escape hatch beyond that.

Investigation confirmed active-trip auto-matching (getPlannedLegCandidatesForActiveTrip's JOIN to trips ON is_active = 1) and ground-session auto-matching are both structurally trip-scoped already and need no change: a loose leg simply can never be an automatic-match candidate, which is correct and unrelated to this run's scope (auto-linking is inherently an active-trip concept; manual link is unaffected because it looks the leg up by id alone, with no trip involved). Both Phase 2's task and this plan call this out explicitly as verify-only so no implementer invents matching-logic changes that aren't needed.

phases.name: Backend: schema, core CRUD and routes for loose planned legs
phases.ships: A prefile flight plan (.lnmpln upload or SimBrief import) can be created with no trip via two new routes, coexists in storage with trip-linked prefiles, and a unified listing endpoint returns both kinds together — verified by curl and Vitest against a scratch server and scratch db. Not yet reachable from the UI (Phase 3).

phases.name: Backend: FlightManager and ACARS null-trip tolerance
phases.ships: A flight linked to a loose prefile is tracked, reported in GET /api/status, and served by ACARS (dispatch release, weather requests, OOOI events) and ground-session dispatch/loadsheet access exactly as a flight linked to a trip-linked prefile is today — verified end-to-end against a scratch server with a manually created loose leg and a real flight.

phases.name: Frontend: loose-prefile creation, unified listing, and No-trip surfacing
phases.ships: A user who is not inside a trip can prefile a flight plan from a new page, see every prefile (loose and trip-linked, loose marked "No trip") in one unified list, edit/cancel a loose prefile the same way as a trip-linked one, and link a loose prefile to a flight from the existing pickers — with every page that used to assume a planned leg always has a trip now degrading to "No trip" instead of a broken link or a blank value.

tasks.title: Freeze the loose-prefile contract: schema migration, CRUD scoping, REST surface, and client type mirror
tasks.goal: Design the full contract for making planned_legs.trip_id optional: the live-db migration strategy (SQLite has no ALTER COLUMN, and applySchema()'s CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS idiom never touches an existing table, so the live flights.db's existing NOT NULL constraint needs a real one-time table rebuild, gated to run exactly once), duplicate-detection and seq scoping for legs with no trip, the CreatePlannedLegInput/findPlannedLegBySource signatures, the new unified-listing surface AC5 needs, the two new loose-creation routes, the FlightManager/types.ts null-tolerance contract, and the client-side type mirror and "No trip" display convention so Phases 2 and 3 can implement without further decisions. Write .claude/runs/2026-09-16-loose-flight-prefile/design.md with numbered sections (cite them as ctx.sh design 2026-09-16-loose-flight-prefile <n> in later tasks).
acceptance_criteria: States the exact DDL for planned_legs.trip_id (dropping NOT NULL, keeping REFERENCES trips(id) ON DELETE CASCADE) and specifies the one-time rebuild recipe for an EXISTING table (new table with the nullable column, INSERT INTO ... SELECT, drop old, rename, recreate every index), gated by checking PRAGMA table_info(planned_legs) for trip_id's notnull flag so it runs exactly once, in the same idempotent style as the existing PRAGMA table_info + ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN migrations already in src/db/schema.ts.

States whether the rebuild needs PRAGMA foreign_keys OFF/ON bracketing given planned_waypoints, planned_alternates, acars_messages, flights and ground_sessions all hold a foreign key referencing planned_legs.id, and planned_legs itself references trips.id — verified against real SQLite ALTER TABLE RENAME/foreign-key semantics, not assumed.

States that idx_planned_legs_trip(trip_id, seq) and idx_planned_legs_source(trip_id, source_sha256) need no structural change (SQLite index keys admit NULL) — or specifies the alternative if it decides otherwise, with the reason.

Specifies findPlannedLegBySource's new signature, findPlannedLegBySource(tripId: number | null, sha256: string), and the exact SQL predicate that scopes "no trip" as its own duplicate-detection pool distinct from every trip's pool and from every other loose leg only by sha256 (SQLite's `trip_id = NULL` never matches, so the predicate must use IS or an explicit OR NULL branch).

Specifies seq assignment for a loose leg using SQLite's IS operator (`WHERE trip_id IS ?`, matching NULL to NULL), states this is the only change needed in createPlannedLeg's seq query, and states as frozen/out-of-scope that reorderPlannedLegs and PATCH /trips/:id/planned-legs/order stay trip-scoped only — loose legs are excluded from reordering and always list in seq/id order the same way trip legs do.
Specifies CreatePlannedLegInput.tripId: number | null as the only change to that interface.

Specifies the new unified-listing function and route (name, path and response shape) that returns every planned leg — loose and trip-linked — with children attached, and states its ordering rule; states explicitly that GET /trips/:id/planned-legs is unchanged and keeps returning only that trip's legs.

Specifies the two new loose-creation routes: POST /api/planned-legs (multipart .lnmpln, mirrors POST /trips/:id/planned-legs minus the trip lookup/404) and POST /api/planned-legs/simbrief (JSON, mirrors the trip-nested SimBrief route minus the trip lookup/404), and states their response shapes (FileOutcome / result objects) are identical to their trip-nested counterparts so existing client-side response parsing can be reused unchanged.

States that PATCH /api/planned-legs/:legId, DELETE /api/planned-legs/:legId, and PUT /api/flights/:id/planned-leg need NO route-shape change, since all three are already keyed by legId or flightId rather than tripId.

Specifies the FlightManager contract change: PlannedLegCache.tripId/.tripName (src/flightManager.ts) become number | null / string | null; types.ts's PlannedLegLiveStatus.tripId/.tripName become number | null / string | null (matching the precedent GroundSessionLiveStatus already sets in the same file); states that buildPlannedLegCache and buildGroundSessionCache must call getTripName(leg.trip_id) only when leg.trip_id !== null, setting tripName: null otherwise, and that getTripName's own signature (tripId: number) does not change.

States as a frozen, verify-only fact (not new design) that getPlannedLegCandidatesForActiveTrip()'s JOIN to trips ON is_active = 1 structurally excludes every loose leg from automatic leg-matching and ground-session auto-matching, that this is correct and intentional (auto-matching is inherently an active-trip concept), and that manual link via PUT /api/flights/:id/planned-leg is unaffected since it looks the leg up by id alone.

States as a frozen, verify-only fact that src/routes/acars.ts, src/acars.ts, src/db/acarsMessages.ts and src/routes/groundSessions.ts need no contract change: every read/write there is keyed by planned_leg_id or flight_id, never trip_id (confirmed by grep during planning — zero matches).

Specifies the client-side mirror: client/src/types.ts's PlannedLeg.trip_id becomes number | null (PlannedLegWithChildren inherits it) and PlannedLegLiveStatus.tripId/.tripName become number | null / string | null, mirroring the server 1:1.

States the literal "No trip" display convention used wherever a trip name would otherwise show for a planned leg, and states that no `Link to={`/trip/${trip_id}`}` site may ever render with trip_id null (must guard or omit the link).

Specifies the new unified Prefiles page's minimum content: every planned leg (loose and trip-linked) with its status badge, route, and either a trip link or the literal "No trip" with no link; a creation section reusing the existing .lnmpln upload and SimBrief import UI patterns from TripDetail.tsx, posting to the two new loose routes.
Contains no implementation code beyond DDL and interface/type stubs.

tasks.title: Loose-planned-leg schema migration, CRUD, and routes
tasks.goal: Implement the contract frozen in ctx.sh design 2026-09-16-loose-flight-prefile 1 2 3 4 5 6: make planned_legs.trip_id nullable with a real migration for the existing live schema (not just fresh-DB DDL), update CRUD (create/find-by-source/seq/list-all) for loose legs, and add the two loose-creation routes plus the unified-listing route.
acceptance_criteria: planned_legs.trip_id is nullable per design.md's DDL section on both a fresh database and an existing one: a new Vitest case in tests/db/schema.test.ts hand-builds a pre-migration planned_legs table (trip_id NOT NULL) with a seeded row, calls applySchema(), and asserts PRAGMA table_info(planned_legs) reports trip_id notnull=0 while the seeded row survives with every column unchanged; calling applySchema() a second time is a no-op (no duplicate rebuild, no error, no row change) — run with `npm test -- schema.test`.

A scratch copy of the real flights.db is upgraded end to end: `cp flights.db flights.db-wal flights.db-shm $SCRATCH/`, start a scratch server against the copy on another port under Node 20, then read the copy read-only with better-sqlite3 to confirm PRAGMA table_info(planned_legs) now shows trip_id nullable and that `select count(*) from planned_legs`, `from flights`, `from trips` match the live file's pre-migration counts exactly.

createPlannedLeg accepts tripId: number | null; seq for a loose leg is computed with `WHERE trip_id IS ?`; a Vitest test in tests/db/plannedLegs.test.ts inserts two loose legs and asserts they get seq 1 then 2, and that an existing trip's seq numbering is unaffected.

findPlannedLegBySource(tripId: number | null, sha256) treats "no trip" as its own duplicate pool: a Vitest test proves two loose legs with the same sha256 are detected as duplicates of each other, and that a loose leg is NOT a duplicate of a trip-linked leg sharing the same sha256 (and vice versa).

The new unified-listing function/route from design.md returns every planned leg — loose and trip-linked — with children attached; a Vitest test seeds one of each and asserts both appear in the result.
GET /trips/:id/planned-legs is unchanged: a test or curl check confirms it still returns only that trip's legs, same shape as before.

POST /api/planned-legs (loose .lnmpln upload) and POST /api/planned-legs/simbrief (loose SimBrief import) exist and mirror their trip-nested counterparts' response shapes exactly: `curl -F lnmpln=@samples/lnmpln/<a real fixture> http://localhost:<scratch-port>/api/planned-legs` against a scratch server returns 201 with a created leg whose trip_id is null, and the response's `results`/`imported`/`batch` fields match the trip-nested route's shape field-for-field.
PATCH /api/planned-legs/:legId, DELETE /api/planned-legs/:legId and PUT /api/flights/:id/planned-leg have no route-shape changes in this diff — confirm by reading the diff, not just asserting it.

tests/helpers/db.ts's seedPlannedLeg no longer forces `trip_id: number` in its `over` type (it becomes `number | null`), and its comment "trip_id is required: a planned leg with no trip is not a reachable state" is corrected to say null is now a supported, reachable state.
npx tsc (or npm run build) and npm test both pass with zero failures.
No change to flights.flight_plan_name or the flight_plans/ directory in this diff.
